items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think Slowdrag bought his bass when he quit. Now, he's another one, I believe, joined church or something and gave up bass. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, it's Prince Bacturo.

ctx.x: and to the right, up high. That's Morrison, this fella, Morrison. Oh, yes. Morris, yeah. Dave Morrison.
I think Slowdrag bought his bass when he quit. Now, he's another one, I believe, joined church or something and gave up bass.
Yeah, it's Prince Bacturo. Oh, yes. Way in the back with a baritone.
